mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been above 5.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS declined in the last month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with sustained PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1000 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 for two consecutive months, it indicates a slowdown in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with sustained INDPRO growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
